name: Buds Notifier
description:
Windows-style popup cards for your Bluetooth earbuds and headsets: connected with battery (left/right/case with BudsLink), disconnected, low battery, and a Swift-Pair-like 'nearby' card with a Connect button. Works automatically for every paired headset.

Optional: install BudsLink (Flathub) for per-earbud and case battery. The nearby card needs a Bluetooth adapter with hardware advertisement filtering and BlueZ experimental features (see the extension's preferences).
